notes: Pixel-hash lock of the static world: the pixel sha256 of every shot of set lock-v1 rendered at 1600×900 spp 4 review in Chrome 154.0.8037.95 on Intel(R) UHD Graphics (display driver 31.0.101.2145, queried when the lock was written). Rendering is deterministic for a fixed code + Chrome + driver + settings, so a shot whose hash changes was changed by the code. Verify: pnpm qa --set lock-v1 --w 1600 --h 900 --spp 4 --batch 13 --label lock-v1-verify, then pnpm lock --verify renders/qa/<stamp> (exit 0 identical, 1 changed / missing, 2 Chrome or driver differ — hashes advisory, 3 other settings — not comparable). After a Chrome or driver update, re-render the set on the locked code and re-write the lock (pnpm lock --write <run> --set lock-v1) before judging changes. Commit = the checkout the lock was written from (dirty = uncommitted tracked changes).
